uploadsafety-upload-rejected: Error shown when an image upload is blocked by a moderation check.
uploadsafety-upload-rejected-debug: Debug error shown when an image upload is blocked. $1 is screening detail (checks, labels, scores, threshold).
uploadsafety-upload-unavailable: Error shown when a moderation check cannot be reached and the upload is rejected.
uploadsafety-upload-unavailable-debug: Debug error shown when a moderation check fails. $1 is the failure reason.
uploadsafety-debug-approved: Notice shown on the next page after a successful image upload when debug mode is enabled. $1 is screening detail (checks, labels, scores, threshold).
uploadsafety-upload-screen-limited: Error shown when a user has sent too many images to screening in a short time (an abuse limit, not related to content).
uploadsafety-upload-screen-limited-debug: Debug version of {{msg-mw|uploadsafety-upload-screen-limited}}. $1 is screening detail.
uploadsafety-upload-reject-limited: Error shown when a user had too many images rejected recently and uploads are refused until the limit resets.
uploadsafety-upload-reject-limited-debug: Debug version of {{msg-mw|uploadsafety-upload-reject-limited}}. $1 is screening detail.
uploadsafety-upload-unscreened-restricte: Upload error shown to users without the uploadsafety-upload-unscreened right when they upload a file in a format that is not screened (e.g. SVG, PDF, video).
log-name-uploadsafety:
{{doc-logpage}}
Name of the upload safety log.
log-description-uploadsafety: Description of the upload safety log, shown at the top of Special:Log/uploadsafety.
logentry-uploadsafety-reject:
{{Logentry}}
Parameters:
* $4 - surface (upload, avatar, banner)
* $5 - comma-separated names of the checks that rejected the image (e.g. nsfw)
* $6 - their scores, in the same order
* $7 - SHA-1 of the rejected file
logentry-uploadsafety-suspect:
{{Logentry}}
The image was allowed, but some checks scored it in their doubtful range (not enough of them to reject it), so a moderator may want to review it.

Parameters:
* $4 - surface (upload, avatar, banner)
* $5 - comma-separated names of the checks that found it doubtful (e.g. nsfw)
* $6 - their scores, in the same order
* $7 - SHA-1 of the file
logentry-uploadsafety-limited:
{{Logentry}}
Parameters:
* $4 - surface of the upload that reached the limit
* $5 - name of the rate limit (uploadsafety-reject or uploadsafety-reject-daily)
